scenes.heading: Git
scenes.caption: Git is a tool that remembers every saved version of your project. A commit is one saved snapshot with a message about why it exists. It is how teams work on the same code without overwriting each other, and how you undo a change that looked fine yesterday.

items: Git is a tool that remembers every saved version of your project
A commit is one saved snapshot with a message about why it exists
It is how teams work on the same code without overwriting each other, and how you undo a change that looked fine yesterday

scenes.heading: Step by step: Git
scenes.caption: Change a few files that belong to one idea. Stage those files. Commit with a message that says why. Push when you want the copy on the server to include that snapshot.

items: Change a few files that belong to one idea.
Stage those files.
Commit with a message that says why.
Push when you want the copy on the server to include that snapshot.
